page.overview:
Who is God's Crimson Radiance?

God's Crimson Radiance is a special trait of the Super Saiyan God form.

The "God's Crimson Radiance" is a term used to describe the staggering power increase of the Super Saiyan God transformation. When the transformation wears off, the remainder of its strength is retained by its user during battle thanks to the user's body imprinting on the experience with the form, resulting in a powerful aftereffect for the user. Having God's Crimson Radiance also grants the user a degree of resistance to lesser dark magic.

During Beerus and Goku's battle of gods, Goku dropped out of Super Saiyan God mid-fight but managed to somehow retain the power of the transformation in his Super Saiyan form. Not realizing his change in appearance, Goku continued his attempt to pressure Beerus until he was forced to hold off the Destroyer's Sphere of Destruction, at which point Beerus surmised to him that his body had adapted to the level of strength brought on by Super Saiyan God and retained the "God's Crimson Radiance" the latter transformation had initiated, meaning that he had not truly gotten weaker at all. Eventually, Goku reawakened the full Super Saiyan God transformation in a last-ditch effort to disperse the Beerus Ball.

Later, Goku realized that due to the way his body had adapted to Super Saiyan God's power increase when in Super Saiyan, it would be better to further adapt it to his base form as well as his mastered Super Saiyan state. As such, training under Whis allowed him to improve his adjustments to the power in base form, becoming a Saiyan beyond God, and in turn evolving his Super Saiyan form into Super Saiyan Blue. Vegeta would also master divine energy in his Super Saiyan state to also achieve the Blue form.
